data.name: Astral Planes
data.detailed_description:
Astral Planes is music that you move through. It's a composition that's never quite finished. It's a performance, but you begin with some notes someone else has written. It's drifting, but with purpose.

You drift through cosmic dust to uncover tones. Tones feed stars, stars release fragments, you chase them, carry them and commit them to time. This is your record.

data.short_description: Astral Planes is music you move through. Drift across cosmic dust, uncover tones, feed stars, chase fragments, and carry them into the rhythm until movement, sound, and time are pressed into your record.
